description: Open-web-only method used (not LexisNexis): 20 captured English/Bengali search prompts included general/weekly October windows, local-language and topic-specific searches (rape/impunity, jute/labor, elections, anti-France), event follow-ups, and a November neighbor-month query. Search tool returned selected result headers only; native totals/timestamps were unavailable. Coverage is bounded and not exhaustive.
required_followup: Use accessible newspaper archives and rights-source records for any material unresolved candidate; do not infer zero protests.

description: Anti-rape reporting says programmes began 5 October, gives around 400–500 at the 16 October long march, and documents a 21 October Shahbagh blockade. First qualifying 50+ gathering, whether the march/blockade are phases of one event, and the campaign end are not resolved.
required_followup: Find dated 5 October attendance and after-21 October reports; review event boundary against the codebook.

description: The 5 October DLA procession to the PMO meets state-target criteria but no attendance estimate is available; linked September activity may affect onset ownership.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous crowd estimate and September/November episode records.

description: Two exact New Age targets could not support body claims: Feni URL 119201 produced Internal Error without HTTP status, and anti-France URL 120406 returned HTTP 403. Both were left untouched after the observed failures; the latter is an actual URL-specific denial. The 30–31 October gathering lead remains unverified.
required_followup: Use a different permitted contemporaneous publisher for 30–31 October only if the local target assessment finds no restriction; do not retry these exact URLs.
